quotes.text: // Reporting one Local Folders account is not that useful. Skip it.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Account, address-book and calendar reports set a current aggregate; setup successes/failures and FileLink/send actions add events. Account reporting seeds common types with0 to reset removed accounts, skips none Local Folders, and names IM protocols im_<normalizedName>. Proposed manual metric rule: preserve population and sampling semantics when replacing a probe; changing set into add would accumulate repeated snapshots.
title: Use set for configuration snapshots and add for counted events
